mapper.select: SELECT attr_key AS attrKey, attr_name AS attrName, attr_type AS attrType, default_value AS defaultValue FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY attr_key
SELECT attr_key AS attrKey, attr_name AS attrName, attr_type AS attrType, default_value AS defaultValue FROM public.attribute_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND attr_key = #{attrKey}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.attribute_definitions (game_id, attr_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, attr_name, attr_type, default_value, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{attrKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{attrName}, #{attrType}, #{defaultValue}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, attr_key) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, attr_name = EXCLUDED.attr_name, attr_type = EXCLUDED.attr_type, default_value = EXCLUDED.default_value, updated_at = NOW()
